highlights: See the disk, memory and CPU use of your server in Server settings › Storage, and get an alert when one passes a level.
Side threads now take images and files, show question cards, and show how full their context is, with a Compact button.
A thread that you read on one device is read on your other devices too.
OpenBot starts again after an upgrade when its database has broken links from an earlier version.
Remote Desktop works again on Windows, and the Apple apps and Messages tools can ask macOS for Automation access.
